scope.extended_comparison: historical series longer than 153 years preferred; source-specific gaps retained

scientific_rules.calendar: UTC dates and JD_TDB/TT for orbital ephemerides, explicit conversion; historical Julian/Gregorian and Japanese era calendar metadata separate
scientific_rules.epistemic: SOURCE != IMAGE != MEASUREMENT != MODEL != INFERRED_CAUSE != PREDICTION
scientific_rules.51y_hypothesis: test alongside 50y and 52y and physical alternatives; never pre-label as true
null_controls: seasonal deseasonalization without leaking test windows
scientific_rules.promotion: DENY without independent held-out multicycle evidence
safeguards: never use quake or storm derived outcome time to select predictor after the fact
planetary gravitational acceleration differs from local tidal gradient
photographs are shape/coverage context, not gravity measurement
weather and gravity coupling separate unless quantified
hydrologic extreme events need wind, pressure, tide and river flow controls
Juno Jupiter dynamical analog is not Earth predictor
